# Synthetic comics corpus

These invented panel descriptions are the entire accessible source. No rendered
panels, lettering samples, colors, or original art are available. The named creators
are fictional. Panel labels are source locations.

## C1. The spare seat

Writer and artist: Ivo Reed. Medium: silent three-panel comic.

- C1.1: Wide view of a bus stop. Two people sit at opposite ends of the bench. A bag
  occupies the middle seat
- C1.2: Same view. One person lifts the bag onto their knees
- C1.3: Same view. The other person moves one seat closer. No one looks at anyone

## C2. The queue

Writer: Esme Lake. Artist: Ren Bell. Medium: four-panel comic with dialogue.

- C2.1: Close view of a hand holding ticket 41. Speech from outside the panel asks,
  "How long?"
- C2.2: Wide view of an empty waiting room. A display reads 40
- C2.3: Same wide view. The display still reads 40. Speech from outside the panel
  says, "Nearly there"
- C2.4: Close view of ticket 41 folded into a tiny chair

## C3. Attribution note

The panel descriptions were supplied by a fictional archivist, Lin Moss. They are
not creator commentary. No script drafts establish whether Esme or Ren chose the
framing in C2. The silence of C1 is not a shared dialogue rule.
